_meta.what: One turn: the session's agent starts two sub-agents of an agent the session did not register. Each dispatch ends failed with the engine's reason as a string rawOutput. Each line after this one is the params of one session/update the engine sent, in order: every frame carrying _meta.kiro.agentSubtaskId, then turn_completion and session_usage.
